versions.changelog:
- Initial release of wiki-intent-scope.
- Converts user needs and free-form requests into structured research task definitions for Wiki research projects.
- Extracts and normalizes research objects, decomposes client statements, and identifies key elements including management and research problems, research intents, and research scope parameters.
- Integrates with wiki-normalize for standardized research object processing.
- Summarizes current assumptions, confirmation items, output scope, and risks, supporting both human-readable (scope.md) and machine-readable (scope.json) formats.
- Enables iterative task refinement without requiring users to fill in templates or block progress on missing details.
